subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Tea as Global Connector
description: Learn Tea as Global Connector in one minute.

hook.text: Every inhabited continent has a tea tradition. No other drink is prepared in so many different ways by so many people.

buildup.text: China whisks, India boils, Britain steeps, Morocco pours, Japan meditates. Same leaf, radically different rituals.

discovery.text: Tea crossed cultures through trade, colonialism, migration, and religion—adapting to each society while keeping its core identity.

twist.text: Despite globalization, local tea cultures are strengthening. People want both Starbucks and grandma’s recipe.

climax.text: The United Nations designated May 21 as International Tea Day—recognizing tea's role in economies, health, and cultural identity.

punchline.text: One plant, one world, infinite traditions. Tea connects everyone.
